subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can read 'Fun at the Park' and answer questions.
I can put the events of 'The Camel Race' in order.
I can say how a good friend helps.

tf.s: Maryam and Badriya are good friends.

tf.why: Maryam has the basketball. Badriya has a tennis racket.

tf.s: Maryam's basketball goes into a big tree.
tf.why: Right! That is the problem in the story.

tf.s: Badriya uses her tennis racket to get the ball.
tf.why: Well done! Her racket helps get the ball.

tf.s: 'Fun at the Park' happens on a Monday.
tf.why: The day in the story is Friday.

tf.s: The child never watches camel racing.
tf.why: The child often watches camel racing with Dad.
Yes! Farha stops, and then the child helps.

tf.s: The child rides a bike to Farha.
tf.why: Right! The child rides a bike to Farha.

tf.s: Farha wins the race before she stops.
tf.why: First she stops, then she runs again and wins.

tf.s: The camels in the story are white.
tf.why: The camels in the story are brown.
